findings.text: the negative_control_note cites graph_after.json inside the run directory, but the file was written to node-local scratch under /tmp and is gone, so the cited control artefact cannot be opened by a later reader.

the owner test asserts only that the two pins agree on one version and not which version, so reverting both sites to 0.11.0 keeps every test green and no test asserts the graph's active grammar version, leaving the pin's value unguarded against regression.
